name: ai-idp-modular
description: AI-Powered Integrated Developer Platform with Multi-Agent Architecture, Shared Utilities, and Production Web Application

scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev:meta-agent" "npm run dev:infrastructure" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:meta-agent && npm run build:infrastructure && npm run build:web
scripts.build:shared: npm run build:utils && npm run build:types && npm run build:mcp-client && npm run build:qdrant-client
scripts.test: concurrently "npm run test:shared" "npm run test:meta-agent" "npm run test:infrastructure" "npm run test:web"
scripts.test:shared: npm run test:utils && npm run test:types && npm run test:mcp-client
scripts.test:utils: cd packages/shared/utils && npm run test || echo 'No tests configured for utils'
scripts.test:types: cd packages/shared/types && npm run test || echo 'No tests configured for types'
scripts.test:mcp-client: cd packages/shared/mcp-client && npm run test || echo 'No tests configured for mcp-client'
scripts.test:meta-agent: cd packages/meta-agent && npm run test || echo 'Meta-agent not yet created'
scripts.lint: concurrently "npm run lint:shared" "npm run lint:meta-agent" "npm run lint:infrastructure" "npm run lint:web"
scripts.lint:shared: npm run lint:utils && npm run lint:types && npm run lint:mcp-client
scripts.lint:utils: cd packages/shared/utils && npm run lint || echo 'No lint configured for utils'
scripts.lint:types: cd packages/shared/types && npm run lint || echo 'No lint configured for types'
scripts.lint:mcp-client: cd packages/shared/mcp-client && npm run lint || echo 'No lint configured for mcp-client'
scripts.lint:meta-agent: cd packages/meta-agent && npm run lint || echo 'Meta-agent not yet created'
scripts.lint:infrastructure: cd packages/agents/infrastructure && npm run lint || echo 'Infrastructure agent lint not configured'
scripts.type-check: concurrently "npm run type-check:shared" "npm run type-check:meta-agent" "npm run type-check:infrastructure" "npm run type-check:web"
scripts.type-check:shared: npm run type-check:utils && npm run type-check:types && npm run type-check:mcp-client && npm run type-check:qdrant-client
scripts.type-check:qdrant-client: cd packages/shared/qdrant-client && npm run type-check || echo 'Qdrant client not available'
scripts.type-check:meta-agent: cd packages/meta-agent && npm run type-check || echo 'Meta-agent not yet created'
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.health: curl -f http://localhost:3002/api/agent || echo 'Server not running. Start with: npm run dev'
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/.next packages/*/node_modules packages/*/*/dist packages/*/*/.next packages/*/*/node_modules docs-generated packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo packages/*/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm run install:shared && npm run install:agents && npm run install:web
scripts.install:shared: cd packages/shared/utils && npm install && cd ../types && npm install && cd ../mcp-client && npm install

author: Platform Engineering Team
